if: the transaction is the rendering of services

performance consists of the execution of a single act, OR the services yet to be performed are so significant in relation to the transaction taken as a whole that performance cannot be deemed complete until those acts are executed
no significant uncertainty exists regarding the amount of the consideration
then: revenue is recognised WHEN THE SOLE OR FINAL ACT TAKES PLACE and the service becomes chargeable
note: The method is selected by the pattern of performance, not by preference. AS 9 para 12 requires performance to be measured under whichever of the two methods relates the revenue to the work accomplished. Choosing this method where many acts of comparable significance remain defers revenue that has already been earned.
